title: Ocean Sentinel Permanent Project Governance Rules and Incident Memory

rules.triggering_incident: LWA marked sufficient with only 1 parent scene
rules.root_cause: Evaluating class presence rather than independent parent acquisition diversity
rules.failed_assumption: Class present in dataset implies dataset sufficiency for that class
rules.missed_guardrail: Contractual parent diversity check per class
rules.new_guardrail: assert class_parents >= required_parents (>= 2 for all core lookalikes)
rules.permanent_rule: Never evaluate a criterion by class presence; evaluate literal contractual conditions (parent diversity >= required threshold).

rules.triggering_incident: Conflation of 2,550 vs 2,560 coordinate span
rules.root_cause: Ambiguity between 0-indexed endpoint span (2550) vs cell count / coordinate bounds (2560)
rules.failed_assumption: Array index span equals cell-centered spatial extent
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit distinction between index coordinate span and cell count
rules.new_guardrail: Explicitly assert cell count vs coordinate span conventions in geometry audits
rules.permanent_rule: Distinguish index span from cell count and coordinate convention in all spatial calculations.

rules.triggering_incident: 50m design evaluation buffer described as physical registration uncertainty
rules.root_cause: Confusing an algorithmic tolerance parameter with empirical physical measurement uncertainty
rules.failed_assumption: Design tolerance parameter equals physical uncertainty
rules.missed_guardrail: Epistemic separation of design parameters from measured empirical uncertainty
rules.new_guardrail: Disallow labeling algorithmic window/buffer parameters as physical registration uncertainty
rules.permanent_rule: Design or evaluation parameter != physical uncertainty. Physical uncertainty requires empirical ground-truth validation.

rules.triggering_incident: 15.79m residual described as independent physical alignment error
rules.root_cause: Confusing conditional mathematical residual under an assumed correspondence model with independent physical registration error
rules.failed_assumption: Optimization residual under a correspondence model equals independent physical error
rules.missed_guardrail: Conditional engineering reconstruction boundary disclosure
rules.new_guardrail: Mandatory CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_RECONSTRUCTION epistemic disclosure
rules.permanent_rule: Conditional residual under an assumed correspondence != independently validated physical registration.

rules.triggering_incident: Four-corner interpolation zero residual claimed as alignment proof
rules.root_cause: Mathematical identity of fitting control points by construction confused with independent empirical validation
rules.failed_assumption: Zero residual on fitted control points validates spatial accuracy across the scene
rules.missed_guardrail: Guardrail rejecting circular verification where test points are fitting points
rules.new_guardrail: Prohibit treating control-point interpolation residual as independent spatial accuracy
rules.permanent_rule: Interpolation fitting control points by construction is not independent validation.

rules.triggering_incident: 47 declared catalog labels treated as 47 physically evaluated images
rules.root_cause: Conflating catalog metadata declarations with materialized physical imagery on disk
rules.failed_assumption: Metadata catalog entry implies physical image availability and validation
rules.missed_guardrail: Physical file existence and hash verification before reporting dataset size
rules.new_guardrail: Physical filesystem verification of all candidate tiles (sample_count on disk)
rules.permanent_rule: Catalog declaration != physical imagery. Only materialized, hash-verified files constitute physical data.

rules.triggering_incident: Catalog splits treated as physical train/dev/holdout datasets
rules.root_cause: Confusing catalog-level partition definitions with populated physical splits
rules.failed_assumption: A split defined on paper exists in the physical domain
rules.missed_guardrail: Physical partition membership reconciliation
rules.new_guardrail: Reconcile physical sample paths against partition assignments in split manifest
rules.permanent_rule: Catalog partition != physically populated dataset.

rules.triggering_incident: Class presence in false positives treated as causal model explanation
rules.root_cause: Inferring causal failure mechanism from observational correlation of class presence
rules.failed_assumption: Co-occurrence of a lookalike feature implies it caused the false positive
rules.missed_guardrail: Separation of empirical correlation from causal attribution
rules.new_guardrail: Disallow asserting causal failure mechanisms without controlled counterfactual ablation
rules.permanent_rule: Class presence != causal model failure. Co-occurrence is not proof of causality.

rules.triggering_incident: Firewall architecture language conflated with empirical demonstration of zero overlap
rules.root_cause: Confusing a protective containment mechanism with an empirical measurement of overlap absence
rules.failed_assumption: A firewall rule guarantees empirical dataset separation without hash verification
rules.missed_guardrail: Empirical hash-level cross-dataset duplication check
rules.new_guardrail: Explicit cryptographic cross-check of image/mask hashes between datasets
rules.permanent_rule: Protective mechanism != empirically demonstrated overlap absence. Trust requires empirical verification.

rules.triggering_incident: Taxonomy terminology drift in C1 reports and tables
rules.root_cause: Informal human-readable labels used in report tables diverging from canonical class definitions
rules.failed_assumption: Informal names are harmless descriptive synonyms
rules.missed_guardrail: Strict taxonomy validator comparing all report terms to ops01_taxonomy_v1.json
rules.new_guardrail: Prohibit drift terms (e.g. Organic Film, Oil Front, Marine Organisms, Rain Cell)
rules.permanent_rule: Canonical taxonomy file (ops01_taxonomy_v1.json) is the absolute semantic authority. No informal synonyms.

rules.triggering_incident: OF incorrectly described as Class 8 / Oil Slick lookalike
rules.root_cause: Transcribing lookalike codes without checking canonical label register
rules.failed_assumption: OF stands for Oil Film or Class 8 lookalike
rules.missed_guardrail: Validation of class abbreviations against canonical source_label_id and semantic role
rules.new_guardrail: Enforce OF = Ocean Front (label_id=6); BS = Biological Slicks; OS = Mineral Oil Spill (excluded)
rules.permanent_rule: OF = Ocean Front (label_id=6). BS = Biological Slicks. OS = Mineral Oil Spill and remains strictly excluded.

rules.triggering_incident: Geographic labels mixed and described as globally representative
rules.root_cause: Generalizing a multi-basin dataset to global representativeness without geographic coverage proof
rules.failed_assumption: Samples from multiple oceans constitute a globally representative dataset
rules.missed_guardrail: Audit of geographic basin claims against specific coordinates and marine regions
rules.new_guardrail: Enforce specific basin reporting (e.g. 5 ocean basins); prohibit global representativeness claims
rules.permanent_rule: Exact evidence-backed geographic wording only. Never turn a set of labels into globally representative.

rules.triggering_incident: Temporal span (2015-2024) treated as continuous yearly coverage
rules.root_cause: Confusing temporal endpoint span with uniform or continuous temporal sampling
rules.failed_assumption: A dataset with samples from 2015 and 2024 covers the intermediate decade uniformly
rules.missed_guardrail: Year-by-year temporal distribution histogram check
rules.new_guardrail: Disclose exact acquisition date distribution; prohibit claiming continuous coverage
rules.permanent_rule: Endpoint span != continuous temporal representation. Disclose actual temporal sparsity.

rules.triggering_incident: Duplicate masks interpreted as duplicate imagery / contamination
rules.root_cause: Observing identical mask hashes across different tiles without checking image hashes or spatial lineage
rules.failed_assumption: Identical mask implies duplicate data sample
rules.missed_guardrail: Joint image and mask SHA256 uniqueness analysis
rules.new_guardrail: Distinguish all-zero background masks or recurring lookalike patterns from image duplication
rules.permanent_rule: Compare image content and lineage before calling contamination. Duplicate mask != duplicate image.

rules.triggering_incident: Existing TrujilloTileDataset assumed to be directly usable for OPS-01
rules.root_cause: Assuming repository codebase components generalize across different dataset contracts without inspection
rules.failed_assumption: An existing PyTorch Dataset in the repository works for a new dataset format
rules.missed_guardrail: Contractual inspection of input shape, bands, dtype, and read mechanics
rules.new_guardrail: Formal DataLoader contract audit before declaring dataset training-ready
rules.permanent_rule: Repository component existence != dataset compatibility. Verify contracts before assuming reuse.

rules.triggering_incident: OPS-01 discovered to be 1-band 256x256 VV raw intensity, conflicting with 2-band 512x512 assumption
rules.root_cause: Stale implementation assumptions from prior phases not updated with physical data discovery
rules.failed_assumption: All project imagery is 2-band 512x512 normalized float
rules.missed_guardrail: Direct physical tensor profiling of materialized GeoTIFF/raster files
rules.new_guardrail: Inspect physical array shape, bands, and value domain directly from raster files
rules.permanent_rule: Actual physical data characteristics outrank stale implementation assumptions.

rules.triggering_incident: Historical test suite counts confused with fresh execution counts
rules.root_cause: Transcribing previous session logs without re-executing test suites
rules.failed_assumption: A test passed yesterday means it passes now without running it
rules.missed_guardrail: Fresh execution timestamp and exit code capture
rules.new_guardrail: Capture live execution start/end time, exit code, and exact pass/fail counts
rules.permanent_rule: Historical test result != freshly executed result. Always run fresh verification.

rules.triggering_incident: Empty git diff --cached described as clean repository
rules.root_cause: Checking only staged index while ignoring untracked and unstaged working-tree modifications
rules.failed_assumption: Zero staged changes implies a clean git working tree
rules.missed_guardrail: Full three-way git state inspection (status porcelain, diff cached, diff)
rules.new_guardrail: Always inspect git status --porcelain -uall, git diff --cached, and git diff
rules.permanent_rule: 0 staged != clean. Staging, working tree, and untracked files are distinct states.

rules.triggering_incident: P2-C2 authoritative artifacts mutated in place by P3
rules.root_cause: Directly editing closed authoritative artifacts (manifest_v3, sufficiency_v4) to add disclosure fields
rules.failed_assumption: Adding disclosure metadata in place is harmless because data samples were unchanged
rules.missed_guardrail: Cryptographic immutability enforcement on closed authoritative artifacts
rules.new_guardrail: Successor versioning rule: closed artifacts are immutable; create v(N+1) with parent references
rules.permanent_rule: Never modify a closed authoritative artifact in place without an explicit version transition.

rules.triggering_incident: LEVEL_B_ESTABLISHED used without formal operational definitions
rules.root_cause: Assigning a qualitative reproducibility grade without contractual operational evidence criteria
rules.failed_assumption: Reproducibility levels are self-explanatory intuitive grades
rules.missed_guardrail: Formal reproducibility hierarchy specification (Levels 0, A, B, C, D)
rules.new_guardrail: Require formal operational criteria and evidence mapping for every reproducibility claim
rules.permanent_rule: Every reproducibility level must have a precise operational definition and evidence requirement.

rules.triggering_incident: Unbounded recursive repository scan became stuck searching for historical hashes
rules.root_cause: Executing unconstrained recursive filesystem crawl across thousands of files and binaries
rules.failed_assumption: An unbounded search will quickly find historical hashes across the entire disk tree
rules.missed_guardrail: Strict time and scope budget on forensic investigations
rules.new_guardrail: Bounded investigation rule: search only targeted authoritative locations within bounded time
rules.permanent_rule: Bounded investigation is mandatory. Never launch unbounded recursive searches across the repository.

rules.triggering_incident: Part-I SHA discrepancy wording error (7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited))
rules.root_cause: Transcribing typo from prompt/report without verifying exact hash characters
rules.failed_assumption: Prompt narrative typo correctly described the character mismatch
rules.missed_guardrail: Automated string assertion rejecting erroneous 7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited) wording
rules.new_guardrail: Assert absence of 7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited); assert presence of correct 7E vs 7F wording where noted
rules.permanent_rule: The correct documented discrepancy is 7E vs 7F (never 7E vs 7F (erroneous 7B character transcription prohibited)). Verify hashes directly from filesystem.

rules.triggering_incident: Conflation of scientific protocol decisions with engineering implementation choices
rules.root_cause: Allowing engineering implementation ease to decide scientific experimental protocol values
rules.failed_assumption: Choosing a convenient implementation choice does not compromise scientific validity
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit taxonomy of decisions: SCIENTIFIC vs ENGINEERING vs BOTH
rules.new_guardrail: Separate scientific training protocol decisions from engineering choices; freeze protocol before implementation
rules.permanent_rule: Scientific protocol decisions must be frozen before implementation. Engineering decisions must not silently dictate scientific protocol.

rules.triggering_incident: OPS-01 DataLoader contract left open and at risk of premature implementation
rules.root_cause: Desire to quickly implement a DataLoader before scientific protocol is approved
rules.failed_assumption: Implementing a loader early accelerates project progress
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit OPEN-LOADER-001 and OPEN-LOADER-CONTRACT-001 locks
rules.new_guardrail: Enforce that OPS-01 DataLoader is NOT implemented until EXP-07 protocol is formally frozen
rules.permanent_rule: The OPS-01 DataLoader gap remains open until EXP-07 protocol is frozen. The loader must not invent protocol.

rules.triggering_incident: Raw DN vs dB vs sigma0 representation at risk of premature selection
rules.root_cause: Selecting input value domain for convenience without experimental evidence
rules.failed_assumption: Defaulting to raw DN or dB is a trivial implementation detail
rules.missed_guardrail: OPEN-PREPROC-001 formal open issue record
rules.new_guardrail: Document raw DN vs dB vs sigma0 trade-offs; forbid selection during pre-training audit
rules.permanent_rule: Value domain (raw DN / dB / sigma0) is an open scientific decision (OPEN-PREPROC-001). Do not choose prematurely.

rules.triggering_incident: Risk of unauthorized model training or Part-III benchmark leakage
rules.root_cause: Pressure to evaluate downstream performance before data readiness audit is closed
rules.failed_assumption: Running quick exploratory training is harmless to governance
rules.missed_guardrail: Zero EXP-07 artifacts, zero GPU usage, zero Part-III access enforcement
rules.new_guardrail: Assert absence of EXP-07 training runs, check GPU execution prohibition, and verify Part-III isolation
rules.permanent_rule: Training requires separate explicit authorization. Part-III remains protected. EXP-06 remains frozen.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C2-001: Overstated pre-P3 unchanged claims without direct before/after evidence
rules.root_cause: Conflating current filesystem hash matching with historical equality proof
rules.failed_assumption: Current file integrity proves historical artifact identicalness
rules.missed_guardrail: Evidence boundary validator distinguishing current verification from historical equivalence
rules.new_guardrail: Disallow PROVEN claim unless direct pre-P3 byte comparison is demonstrated
rules.permanent_rule: Never promote current-state consistency into historical-state equality. Use PROVEN only when direct before/after evidence exists.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C2-002: Git state interpretation risked calling 0 staged clean
rules.root_cause: Evaluating only git diff --cached while ignoring untracked and modified files
rules.failed_assumption: 0 staged changes means the working tree is clean
rules.missed_guardrail: Complete porcelain audit parsing all four state components
rules.new_guardrail: Full 4-command git state inspection in ops01_p3_c2_git_state_audit_v1.json
rules.permanent_rule: 0 staged != clean. The full working tree state must always be reported from git status --porcelain -uall.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C2-003: Shortened taxonomy name for HM used in governance
rules.root_cause: Informally shortening 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects' to 'Anthropogenic Objects'
rules.failed_assumption: Informal shortened names are acceptable in high-level narrative summaries
rules.missed_guardrail: Exact string equality check against ops01_taxonomy_v1.json class_name
rules.new_guardrail: Assert HM exact class_name == 'Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects' across all governance text
rules.permanent_rule: Canonical class names must strictly match ops01_taxonomy_v1.json. Shortened or informal synonyms are strictly prohibited.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C2-004: Reproducibility Level B required narrower operational semantic wording
rules.root_cause: Broad phrasing at risk of being casually interpreted as 'OPS-01 dataset is fully reproducible'
rules.failed_assumption: Level B label alone prevents misinterpretation by future sessions
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit operational statement bounding Level B to stored verification artifacts
rules.new_guardrail: Require operational statement: 'OPS-01 verification artifacts satisfy Level B deterministic verification reproducibility'
rules.permanent_rule: Level B applies strictly to deterministic audit verification of stored files, never to pipeline or source reconstruction.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-002: Risk of solving Source Control cleanliness through destructive deletion
rules.root_cause: Urge to make Source Control panel clean by deleting untracked files
rules.failed_assumption: Repository cleanliness justifies removing untracked scientific data or artifacts
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit prohibition of git clean or destructive file deletion during hygiene operations
rules.new_guardrail: Prohibit git clean, git reset, and file deletion; resolve hygiene purely through classification and narrow ignore rules
rules.permanent_rule: Repository hygiene must not be achieved through deletion of evidence.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-002: Risk of solving Source Control cleanliness through destructive deletion
rules.root_cause: Conflating untracked status with disposable status
rules.failed_assumption: Files not currently staged or committed have no scientific authority
rules.missed_guardrail: Doctrine explicitly stating untracked files may be authoritative local artifacts
rules.new_guardrail: Treat untracked scientific data, models, and reports as protected until provenance is established
rules.permanent_rule: Untracked != disposable.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-001: Source Control noise caused by large untracked generated/scientific artifact population
rules.root_cause: Deciding file tracking solely by byte size rather than authority and provenance
rules.failed_assumption: Large files should automatically be deleted or ignored without checking if they are frozen baselines
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit evaluation of artifact authority before applying retention policy
rules.new_guardrail: Evaluate whether artifact is frozen, authoritative, derived, or ephemeral before deciding tracking status
rules.permanent_rule: Scientific artifact retention must be decided by provenance and authority, not file size.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-003: Risk of .gitignore hiding authoritative scientific artifacts
rules.root_cause: Broad wildcard patterns in .gitignore accidentally excluding critical files
rules.failed_assumption: Broad ignore rules are harmless if applied to top-level directories
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory protected artifact allowlist audit after every .gitignore modification
rules.new_guardrail: Run git check-ignore against all protected artifacts whenever .gitignore changes
rules.permanent_rule: .gitignore must never hide authoritative scientific artifacts.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C2-002: Git state interpretation risked repeating '0 staged = clean' error
rules.root_cause: Attempting to use .gitignore to conceal existing tracked modifications
rules.failed_assumption: Git ignore rules can or should suppress modifications to tracked files
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit confirmation that tracked modifications remain visible and documented
rules.new_guardrail: Require git diff --name-status verification that tracked modifications are not obscured
rules.permanent_rule: Tracked modifications must never be concealed by ignore rules.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-001: Source Control noise caused by large untracked generated/scientific artifact population
rules.root_cause: Prioritizing aesthetic UI cleanliness ('0 changes') over truthful repository state
rules.failed_assumption: A clean Git status panel indicates scientific correctness
rules.missed_guardrail: Rule establishing that scientific truthfulness outranks UI aesthetics
rules.new_guardrail: Explicitly report remaining legitimate untracked files and forbid artificial clean claims
rules.permanent_rule: Source Control panel cleanliness != repository scientific correctness.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-004: Need for every AG task to self-audit and self-repair its own side effects
rules.root_cause: Completing tasks without auditing newly introduced inconsistencies or broken assertions
rules.failed_assumption: Passing initial tests means the overall state has zero unintended side effects
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory self-audit and self-healing lifecycle before declaring COMPLETE
rules.new_guardrail: Inspect changes, detect introduced inconsistencies, repair them automatically, and re-verify
rules.permanent_rule: Every state-mutating task must audit and repair its own side effects before declaring COMPLETE.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-004: Need for every AG task to self-audit and self-repair its own side effects
rules.root_cause: Terminating with unresolved contradictions instead of blocking or repairing
rules.failed_assumption: Leaving minor known issues for future prompts is acceptable
rules.missed_guardrail: Hard requirement that unresolvable issues must force CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED status
rules.new_guardrail: Forbid Decision A if any known task-introduced defect remains unresolved
rules.permanent_rule: No task may introduce a new inconsistency and then terminate without either resolving it or explicitly marking the phase BLOCKED/CONDITIONAL.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C1-002: Historical hash recovery executed as unbounded repository scan
rules.root_cause: Executing recursive file searches across large trees without depth or path bounds
rules.failed_assumption: Repository-wide rglob(*) will terminate in acceptable time
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory bounded scope and timeout on all directory enumerations
rules.new_guardrail: Require explicit path lists and depth limits for all forensic scans
rules.permanent_rule: Repository investigations must be bounded; never perform unbounded recursive scans.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C3-001: Source Control noise caused by large untracked generated/scientific artifact population
rules.root_cause: Absence of formalized retention policy for generated experimental outputs
rules.failed_assumption: Generated outputs can exist without an explicit category classification
rules.missed_guardrail: Classification into Category A, B, C, or D in ops01_p3_c3_data_tracking_policy_v1.json
rules.new_guardrail: Require every generated artifact class to be registered in the project data tracking policy
rules.permanent_rule: Generated artifacts must have an explicit retention policy: tracked, ignored-retained, externally reproducible, or temporary.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C5-001: Conflation of historical UI snapshot with final post-phase Git state
rules.root_cause: Phase-created artifacts alter the Git count after the phase's intermediate baseline
rules.failed_assumption: Intermediate baseline count equals final repository state after report generation
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory final Git measurement executed strictly after the final artifact creation
rules.new_guardrail: Require final Git inspection to be measured after all artifacts are created, distinguishing intermediate states from final state
rules.permanent_rule: Every final repository-state claim must be measured AFTER all artifacts for that phase are created: INTERMEDIATE GIT STATE != FINAL GIT STATE.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C6-001: C5 timeline omitted phase-created telemetry artifact from final count reconciliation
rules.root_cause: Measuring Git state before the final closure report, tests, or telemetry are written, leading to stale counts
rules.failed_assumption: Git counts can be measured once and remain unchanged even as closure artifacts are created
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory post-artifact final Git inspection order
rules.new_guardrail: Require final Git state measurement to occur strictly after all phase artifacts have been written to disk
rules.permanent_rule: A phase's final Git state must be measured only after all phase artifacts are created.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C6-001: C5 timeline omitted phase-created telemetry artifact from final count reconciliation
rules.root_cause: Ambiguity over whether phase-created telemetry files under scratch/ increment Git porcelain counts
rules.failed_assumption: Telemetry files can be created without documenting their ignore/tracking status
rules.missed_guardrail: Explicit tracking/ignore classification of every phase-created telemetry file
rules.new_guardrail: Account for every phase-created telemetry file: if Git-visible, increment timeline; if matched by .gitignore, document as IGNORED_ARTIFACT with +0 porcelain impact
rules.permanent_rule: A phase-created telemetry file is itself part of the repository-state timeline if Git-visible, and must be explicitly classified if ignored.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C5-001 & INC-P3-C6-001: Intermediate snapshot conflated with final filesystem state
rules.root_cause: Authoring executive summary counts using intermediate filesystem measurements rather than final porcelain output
rules.failed_assumption: Intermediate snapshot counts represent the concluding state of a phase
rules.missed_guardrail: Rule prohibiting executive summaries from using intermediate counts as final counts
rules.new_guardrail: Disallow intermediate counts in executive closure summaries; mandate fresh post-artifact Git verification
rules.permanent_rule: A final report must never use an intermediate filesystem count as its final count.

rules.triggering_incident: INC-P3-C5-001 & INC-P3-C6-001: Agent tasks terminating with post-artifact discrepancies
rules.root_cause: Failing to perform a self-consistency check after creating all phase artifacts
rules.failed_assumption: Pre-artifact verification ensures post-artifact consistency
rules.missed_guardrail: Mandatory post-artifact self-consistency check prior to declaring COMPLETE
rules.new_guardrail: Execute a full self-consistency verification of Git porcelain, report, telemetry, and regression tests after all phase artifacts are authored
rules.permanent_rule: Every state-mutating task must perform a post-artifact self-consistency check before declaring COMPLETE.

rules.title: Missing local metadata does not equal impossible metadata
rules.description: Before concluding that metadata is unavailable, search for external recovery paths: public archives, S3 buckets, API endpoints, and range-request capable remote storage.

rules.title: Calibration of aggregated nonlinear measurements requires explicit error decomposition
rules.description: When applying a nonlinear calibration (e.g., DN^2/A^2) to spatially aggregated data (e.g., block-mean DN), the approximation error must be decomposed into: (1) calibration-parameter variation across the aggregation block, and (2) nonlinear aggregation bias (Jensen inequality). Both must be independently bounded.

rules.title: Supervised task performance does not automatically constitute representation learning
rules.description: Do not claim that a supervised segmentation model produces general-purpose representations without explicit representation-quality evaluation (transfer learning, feature probing, or linear evaluation protocols).

rules.title: A protocol correction must itself receive adversarial review
rules.description: Red-team corrections can introduce new unsupported conclusions, premature freezes, or hidden assumptions. Second-order adversarial review is required before execution of correction plans.

rules.title: Nonlinear calibration after aggregation requires empirical validation
rules.description: When applying nonlinear radiometric calibration equations (e.g. sigma0 = DN^2/A^2) to already-aggregated spatial blocks (e.g. 10x10 block-mean amplitude), mathematical equivalence cannot be assumed. Empirical quantification of the approximation error across stratified parent windows is mandatory before plan freeze.

rules.title: LUT smoothness alone cannot establish aggregation equivalence
rules.description: Spatial smoothness of calibration lookup tables (LUTs) only demonstrates that calibration parameter variation across a block is small (E1 < 0.01%). It does not establish equivalence between calibrate(mean(DN)) and mean(calibrate(DN)), which is governed by within-block amplitude variance via Jensen's inequality (E2).

rules.title: Theoretical speckle CV does not substitute for measured dataset CV
rules.description: Theoretical multi-look speckle predictions (e.g. CV = 0.249 for ENL=4.4 amplitude) apply strictly to fully developed speckle over homogeneous surfaces. Heterogeneous ocean phenomena, slick boundaries, and anthropogenic structures exhibit significantly higher CVs and localized error spikes that must be measured empirically.

rules.title: Instrument radiometric accuracy is distinct from processing approximation error
rules.description: Sensor absolute radiometric calibration accuracy (e.g. Sentinel-1 0.34 dB specification) belongs to the instrument error budget. It must never be cited to justify or excuse algorithmic processing approximation errors (e.g. 0.24 dB Jensen bias). The two error concepts are mathematically and operationally distinct.

rules.title: Reachable metadata does not equal verified metadata content
rules.description: Demonstrating that remote metadata files (e.g. S3 XML headers) return HTTP 200 establishes accessibility, not validity. Authoritative verification requires downloading, parsing XML schemas, and inspecting internal vector arrays and coordinates.

rules.title: Source mask is distinct from validity mask
rules.description: Ground-truth source masks define semantic label annotations and must never be altered on disk to handle padding or invalid sensors. Swath-edge padding and invalid data must be decoupled into an explicit validity mask evaluated at runtime in loss computation.

rules.title: Typical/central errors must not be represented as global worst-case bounds
rules.description: An empirical central tendency metric (e.g. median relative error of ~5.5%) describes typical conditions in homogeneous ocean areas. It must never be represented as a global worst-case bound across all scene features; localized errors at high-reflectivity targets or sharp boundaries can exceed 300%.

rules.title: Multiclass segmentation must not inherit binary threshold semantics
rules.description: Multiclass segmentation protocols must evaluate predictions using argmax or calibrated simplex decision rules. Reusing binary decision thresholds (e.g. EXP-06 tau=0.22) in multiclass contexts is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Implementation contracts must preserve epistemic status
rules.description: Implementation specifications must carry forward all upstream epistemic caveats (e.g. selection-influenced holdout partitions, approximate calibration pathways) without converting conditional engineering approximations into unconditional truth.

rules.title: Effective optimization batch size is distinct from BatchNorm statistical batch size
rules.description: Gradient accumulation aggregates gradients across multiple forward/backward passes to increase the effective optimizer batch size, but each forward pass computes BatchNorm running statistics solely over the physical minibatch. Gradient accumulation must never be claimed to increase or stabilize BatchNorm statistical batch size.

rules.title: Runtime input-domain terminology must distinguish raw uncalibrated DN, physical backscatter, and model-space representation
rules.description: When machine learning models ingest raw or spatially aggregated detector counts (e.g. Sentinel-1 GRD detected DN), documentation and code must explicitly specify the uncalibrated DN domain. It is strictly forbidden to describe uncalibrated or log-transformed DN representations as radiometrically calibrated backscatter (sigma0, gamma0, beta0) or to conflate empirical aggregation studies with runtime physical calibration.

rules.title: Independent recomputation is mandatory for high-impact pipeline validation
rules.description: Validation of critical ML pipeline components (e.g. normalization, loss calculations, confusion matrices, metrics, sampling distributions) must include independent mathematical recomputation from first principles. Asserting that a production helper function agrees with itself does not constitute verification.

rules.title: Training protocol must be frozen before execution; hyperparameter sweeps require formal authorization
rules.description: A baseline machine learning experiment must have its complete training protocol (optimizer, scheduler, loss weights, batch dynamics, stopping criteria) frozen in an authoritative artifact before launching execution. Uncontrolled hyperparameter fishing or simultaneous multi-variable exploration is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Single-seed performance must not be represented as robust statistical evidence
rules.description: A single random seed execution provides preliminary baseline evidence only. Claims of model performance, stability, or superiority must report mean, standard deviation, and min/max ranges across an authorized multi-seed replication set (minimum 3 seeds).

rules.title: Untrained dry-run metrics are pipeline sanity checks, not performance baselines
rules.description: Metrics evaluated on untrained or initialized models during pre-flight CPU dry-runs verify pipeline mechanics and numerical safety only. They must never be compared against trained models or cited as baseline performance numbers.

rules.title: Sampler semantic identity must be mathematically defined and verified across metadata, code, and reporting
rules.description: Any dataset sampling strategy (e.g. Candidate F Hybrid) must have an exact mathematical definition of its component weights (e.g. 70% parent-balanced, 30% class-presence) recorded in machine-readable metadata. Reporting prose must transcribe this definition literally; informal colloquial descriptions (e.g. 50/50 uniform/stratified) are prohibited.

rules.title: Experimental replication must test pre-declared hypotheses, never serve as an unprincipled rescue run
rules.description: Replicate runs (e.g. Seed 101, Seed 2024) must only be authorized after the baseline run (Seed 42) is proven protocol-valid and internally consistent. Replicates exist to measure stochastic variance and empirical stability; they must never be launched to erase or compensate for unfavorable baseline results.

rules.title: Stochastic replicate comparison requires strict ceteris-paribus protocol equivalence; n=2 cannot support population distribution claims
rules.description: Controlled replicates executed to measure stochastic variation must have zero protocol drift from the baseline (identical dataset, normalization, taxonomy, loss, sampler weights, batch dynamics, optimizer, scheduler). Differences must be strictly limited to the random seed and run identity. Comparisons between two seeds (n=2) constitute preliminary variance evidence only and must not be reported as statistically robust confidence intervals or population distributions.

rules.title: Third-seed authorization gate requires formal unresolved stochastic hypothesis; blind accumulation of seeds is prohibited
rules.description: Authorizing a third random seed (e.g. Seed 2024) requires an explicit, pre-declared unresolved scientific question that two seeds cannot settle (e.g. distinguishing bimodal convergence from continuous variance). If two seeds already reveal consistent structural failure modes (e.g. rare-class parent scarcity), research effort must prioritize dataset or representational improvements rather than accumulating redundant training runs.

rules.title: Model parameter and buffer counts must be verified by direct code/checkpoint introspection; prose transcription must match machine-readable configuration exactly
rules.description: Model parameter counts (trainable, non-trainable, floating buffers, integer buffers, state elements) must be computed directly by programmatic inspection of the instantiated PyTorch module and checkpoint tensors. Unverified prose transcription of numbers is prohibited; any discrepancy between markdown text and machine-readable metadata constitutes an incident.

rules.title: Sensor physical modality discipline: Sentinel-1 is spaceborne radar; referring to radar backscatter as acoustic or sonar is strictly prohibited
rules.description: All scientific reports, comments, docstrings, and metadata must strictly adhere to the true physical modality of the sensors used. Sentinel-1 is a C-band (5.405 GHz) microwave synthetic aperture radar measuring radar backscatter cross-section (sigma0) and roughness dampening. Describing SAR backscatter signatures as 'acoustic', 'sonar', or 'sound waves' is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Causal attribution discipline: Multi-seed observational recurrence supports reproducibility, not causal proof; hypotheses must never be marked confirmed without controlled interventional isolation
rules.description: Observational recurrence of an outcome across multiple random seeds (e.g. repeated zero IoU or scene-level collapse) proves empirical reproducibility under a specific protocol, but does NOT establish causality. A hypothesis regarding architecture (e.g. pooling dilution) or data (e.g. parent scarcity) must be classified as PLAUSIBLE or SUPPORTED, and must never be labeled CONFIRMED or PROVEN unless an interventional ablation experiment has isolated the factor.

rules.title: Taxonomy abbreviation fidelity: Class abbreviations must resolve strictly to authoritative canonical taxonomy definitions; OF is Ocean Front, HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects
rules.description: Class abbreviations must resolve strictly to authoritative canonical definitions in ops01_taxonomy_v1.json. OF is Ocean Front (label 6), NOT Oil Film. HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (label 13), and must never be renamed to Ship or Vessel. Mineral oil spills (OS, label 14) are strictly quarantined and excluded from OPS-01 training.

rules.title: Dense Class Index vs Source Label ID Integrity: Dense indices and source label IDs must never be conflated; OF is Dense 5 (Source 6) and POW is Dense 6 (Source 7)
rules.description: All reports, metadata, tests, and code must explicitly specify whether class indices refer to Dense Class Index (0-11) or Source Label ID (0-14). OF is Dense Index 5 (Source Label 6). POW is Dense Index 6 (Source Label 7). Referring to OF as Class 6 without qualification is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: SAR Runtime Input Domain Specification: Uncalibrated DN-domain representation must not be cited as sigma0 or calibrated backscatter
rules.description: Reports and code must accurately distinguish physical sensor measurements, ground-processed Level-1 products, and runtime model inputs. In EXP-07, the input is uncalibrated 10x10 spatially aggregated digital numbers (DN) transformed via log1p and z-score standardized. Citing this runtime tensor as sigma0, gamma0, or calibrated backscatter without applying radiometric calibration LUTs is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Parent-Level Partitioning Before Slicing: Data splits must be formed strictly at the independent parent scene cluster level prior to spatial tiling
rules.description: In all dataset expansion campaigns (including OPS-02), partitioning into TRAIN, DEV, and HOLDOUT must occur strictly at the parent acquisition cluster level BEFORE spatial tiling or patch extraction. Assigning tiles from the same parent scene or correlated orbital pass across different partitions is strictly prohibited as data leakage.

rules.title: Annotation Provenance Tiers: Every sample must record an explicit provenance tier; Tier D weak labels are quarantined from training and evaluation splits
rules.description: All dataset expansion samples must record an explicit annotation provenance tier (Tier A: expert manual; Tier B: specialist-verified semi-automated; Tier C: reconstructed legacy; Tier D: unverified weak label). Samples categorized as Tier D are strictly quarantined and prohibited from entering TRAIN, DEV, or HOLDOUT partitions.

rules.title: Mission Datatake and Orbital Clustering Invariant: Slices sharing datatake IDs must be clustered into a single parent entity prior to partitioning
rules.description: Any candidate scenes sharing a Sentinel-1 mission datatake identifier or adjacent along-track zero-Doppler time range (Delta t < 10 minutes) must be grouped into a single parent acquisition cluster. Treating individual along-track slices from the same datatake as independent parent scenes is strictly prohibited as pseudo-replication.

rules.title: Cross-Source Duplicate and Crosswalk Protection: Independent parent accounting across multiple sources must collapse identical acquisitions
rules.statement: When assembling candidate datasets across multiple catalogs or repositories, acquisitions sharing mission datatake, orbit, platform, acquisition timestamp, or Sentinel product identity must be collapsed and cross-referenced. Cross-source representations of the same physical acquisition must never appear in different partitions or inflate independent sample counts.
rules.rationale: External sources frequently redistribute overlapping Sentinel-1 granules under different filenames or slice boundaries.
rules.enforcement: Cross-source duplicate audits must classify every overlap as duplicate, probable duplicate, distinct, or unresolved.

rules.title: Four-Layer Distinct Quality Control Standard: Technical, Provenance, Semantic, and Independence QC must remain separate
rules.description: Every physical dataset assembly must evaluate and report Technical Integrity, Provenance Integrity, Semantic/Label Integrity, and Scientific Independence as four distinct audit layers. Conflating these layers into a single aggregate '100% QC' figure without reporting individual pass/fail metrics across all four layers is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Dataset Assembly Candidate Freeze vs Model Training Gating: Dataset assembly completion does not authorize training
rules.description: Assembling, verifying, and freezing a physical dataset candidate (e.g. OPS02_v1_CANDIDATE) constitutes a data engineering milestone only. Model training, hyperparameter sweeps, architecture benchmarking, or holdout evaluation remain strictly prohibited until a separate formal scientific training-readiness authorization gate is passed.

rules.title: Semantic Taxonomy Encoding Validity vs Semantic Annotation Ground Truth
rules.statement: A pixel mask whose values lie strictly within the valid range [0..11] proves technical encoding validity, not ground-truth semantic correctness. Scientific reporting must distinguish verified array encoding from external expert annotation authority.
rules.rationale: Conflating valid uint8 integer encodings with ground-truth correctness can conceal annotation ambiguity or systematic labeler bias.
rules.enforcement: Audit scripts and QC reports must report Technical Encoding QC separately from Semantic Annotation Provenance Tiers.

rules.title: Physical Sample Pair Count vs Independent Parent Acquisition Count
rules.statement: Multiple spatial slices derived from the same parent acquisition share identical atmospheric, sensor calibration, and sea state conditions. Data diversity metrics must report the number of independent parent/datatake acquisitions alongside physical sample counts. Conflating tile counts with independent acquisitions is prohibited.
rules.rationale: Treating slices as independent samples produces pseudo-replication and inflates apparent dataset statistical support.
rules.enforcement: Manifests, audits, and reports must use the phrasing: N physical sample pairs derived from M independent parent/datatake acquisitions.

rules.title: Gridded Pixel Alignment vs Physical Georeferencing Verification
rules.statement: A deterministic mathematical window crop and spatial block-averaging that aligns an image array to a label grid proves internal matrix correspondence, not physically validated geographic ground coordinates. Placeholder affine transforms in raster headers must be classified as engineering coordinate frames rather than verified Earth geocoding.
rules.rationale: Claiming geospatial registration validation purely based on dimension and transform existence misleads downstream GIS users.
rules.enforcement: Rasterio CRS/transform headers must be classified as engineering frames unless verified against satellite GCPs or orbit state vectors.

rules.title: Single-Archive Multi-Acquisition Expansion vs Multi-Source Benchmark Independence
rules.statement: Expanding the number of independent parent acquisitions within a single data archive significantly improves intra-archive statistical diversity, but does NOT constitute a multi-source or multi-annotator generalization benchmark. Generalization claims across external domains require independent validation on distinctly sourced datasets.
rules.rationale: An archive produced with consistent sensor parameters and annotation teams cannot validate cross-source transferability.
rules.enforcement: Freeze specifications and training gates must explicitly document single-archive grounding as a scientific limitation.

rules.title: Frozen Dataset Specification Immutability and Cryptographic Binding
rules.statement: A frozen dataset specification artifact cannot be mutated in-place during training tasks. Dataset version identity must incorporate the cryptographic SHA-256 hashes of all underlying physical, parent, and partition manifests. Any discrepancy between specification text and underlying manifests requires a formal amendment task.
rules.rationale: In-place modifications of freeze metadata create epistemic ambiguity regarding dataset identity and undermine audit reproducibility.
rules.enforcement: Training readiness gates must assert that freeze specification SHA-256 matches the cryptographic hash locked at freeze review.

rules.title: Partition Sample Count Runtime Assertion
rules.statement: Every dataset loader in training and evaluation pipelines must assert at runtime that the exact number of loaded samples matches the frozen partition manifest count (e.g. TRAIN=132, DEV=40, HOLDOUT=40). Any mismatch must halt execution immediately prior to model instantiation.
rules.rationale: Prevents silent omission, filtering, or partition divergence during model ingestion.
rules.enforcement: Pre-flight assertions in training scripts: assert len(train_dataset) == manifest['partitions']['TRAIN']['sample_count'].

rules.title: Hardware Provisioning vs Hardware Utilization Reporting
rules.statement: Provisioned accelerator count does not equal utilized accelerator count. Reporting multi-GPU execution requires active process parallelism (DistributedDataParallel or DataParallel). Single-device execution on a multi-GPU runtime must be reported strictly as single-GPU execution.
rules.rationale: Conflating available hardware with actual compute utilization misleads compute efficiency and scalability audits.
rules.enforcement: Environment reporting must separate 'Provisioned Accelerators' from 'Active Compute Devices' and verify model replication.

rules.title: Evaluation Warmup Memory vs Peak Training VRAM Characterization
rules.statement: Static model memory allocated during an eval-mode warmup loop under torch.no_grad() must never be reported as 'peak VRAM consumption'. Peak training VRAM must be measured during active backward pass via torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated().
rules.rationale: Eval-mode tensor residence omits optimizer momentum/variance states, activation graphs, and gradient buffers, drastically understating memory requirements.
rules.enforcement: Telemetry scripts must distinguish 'Eval Tensor Residence' from 'Peak Training VRAM'.

rules.title: Partitioned Reporting for Sparse-Class Multiclass Perception
rules.statement: When evaluating multiclass perception on datasets with ultra-sparse minority phenomena (e.g. classes with < 1,000 pixels or 0 true positives on DEV), macro-averaged mIoU must be reported alongside partitioned sub-metrics separating well-supported oceanic phenomena from ultra-sparse lookalikes.
rules.rationale: Zero-support or ultra-sparse classes collapse the unweighted macro average to single digits, concealing robust model learning on dominant phenomena.
rules.enforcement: Evaluation reports must provide: 1) Full 11-class phenomena mIoU, 2) Well-supported phenomena mIoU, and 3) Per-class IoU tables.

rules.title: Cryptographic Manifest Binding and Freeze Immutability Mandate
rules.statement: Every frozen dataset specification must explicitly embed the cryptographic SHA-256 digests of all constituent physical, partition, and parent manifests. Any manual, automated, or operational in-place modification of an existing freeze specification file is strictly prohibited and invalidates downstream training runs.
rules.rationale: In-place file edits undermine provenance lineage and prevent cryptographic verification of experimental inputs.
rules.enforcement: Pre-training validators must compute the SHA-256 of all bound manifests and halt execution if any hash differs.

rules.title: Runtime Dataset Sample-ID Set Equality Invariant
rules.statement: Runtime training and evaluation loaders must assert exact set equality between loaded sample IDs and the frozen partition manifest sample IDs (set(loaded_ids) == set(manifest_ids)), not merely cardinality/count equality.
rules.rationale: Cardinality checks alone can mask 1-for-1 sample substitutions, partition leakage, or off-by-one errors.
rules.enforcement: Mandatory call to assert_runtime_dataset_integrity() in dataset constructor prior to batch iteration.

rules.title: Epistemic Standard for Scientific Causal Claims vs Descriptive Observation
rules.statement: The classification 'CAUSAL ESTABLISHED' is strictly reserved for outcomes demonstrated through formal single-variable controlled intervention. Performance differences across complex dataset shifts (e.g. OPS-01 to OPS-02) must be classified as 'OBSERVED' performance deltas and analyzed under competing 'PLAUSIBLE' hypotheses until controlled diagnostics isolate the cause.
rules.rationale: Prematurely declaring causality obscures confounding variables and directs engineering efforts toward false solutions.
rules.enforcement: Audit reports and scientific artifacts must distinguish OBSERVED, PLAUSIBLE, SUPPORTED, and CAUSAL ESTABLISHED.

rules.title: Hardware Provisioning vs Compute Utilization Transparency
rules.statement: Experimental run reports must separately report 'Provisioned Hardware' (cloud environment specification) and 'Active Compute Devices' (actual PyTorch device ordinal and parallelism mode). Single-device execution on a multi-accelerator VM must be explicitly documented as single-GPU.
rules.rationale: Conflating VM allocation with code execution misrepresents training efficiency, FLOPs, and scaling properties.
rules.enforcement: Telemetry schema requires active_compute_device_ordinal and parallelism_mode fields.

rules.title: Primary Benchmark Metric Invariance vs Secondary Diagnostic Metrics
rules.statement: The primary frozen benchmark metric (dev_mIoU_phenomena over all classes with GT > 0) cannot be retroactively altered, weighted, or filtered when results are poor. Subgroup metrics (e.g. dominant phenomena mIoU) may be introduced only as secondary diagnostic metrics, and both must be reported concurrently.
rules.rationale: Altering primary metrics post-training corrupts scientific tracking and destroys historical comparability.
rules.enforcement: All evaluation tables must display the primary unweighted macro metric alongside subgroup breakdowns.

rules.title: Canonical Taxonomy Vocabulary and Index Immutability
rules.statement: The 12-class canonical taxonomy (0: BG, 1: AF, 2: BS, 3: LWA, 4: MCC, 5: OF, 6: POW, 7: RF, 8: WS, 9: Eddy, 10: IWs, 11: HM) and its dense index assignments are permanently frozen. Any informal, alternate, or drifted terms (e.g. 'AS', 'Thermal') in training configs, audits, or reports are strictly prohibited.
rules.rationale: Taxonomy drift causes misaligned class weights, corrupted confusion matrices, and uninterpretable metric comparisons.
rules.enforcement: Automated regex and schema validators must reject any dataset or model code referencing unauthorized taxonomy tokens.

rules.title: Canonical Training Protocol Single-Source Authority
rules.statement: All future model training, evaluation, and diagnostic experiments must reference the verified Level 4 frozen protocol (EXP07_P0_C15_PRETRAINING_PROTOCOL_V1.md) and Level 3 canonical reference implementation (src/ocean_sentinel/ml/exp07_reference.py). Narrative report tables cannot introduce or alter hyperparameters without a formal protocol supersession document.
rules.rationale: Narrative errors in intermediate reports must not propagate into downstream execution scripts.
rules.enforcement: Training runner scripts must import and assert configuration values directly from canonical constants.

rules.title: Machine-Readable Forensic Reconstruction Priority
rules.statement: Forensic audits of historical runs must reconstruct hyperparameters, metrics, and execution environments exclusively from direct machine artifacts (JSON run manifests, environment dumps, checkpoint state_dicts, execution stdout/stderr logs). Narrative descriptions in retrospective reports have Level 6 authority and cannot override Level 5 machine records.
rules.rationale: Human-written retrospective narratives frequently introduce transcription errors, rounding differences, or speculative phrasing.
rules.enforcement: Audits must cite specific line numbers in JSON/log execution artifacts rather than text from earlier reports.

rules.title: Cross-Domain Evaluation Epistemic Standard
rules.statement: Cross-domain evaluation across datasets differing in multiple dimensions (such as OPS-01 vs OPS-02) provides descriptive transfer diagnostics only. It cannot be cited as causal identification of specific failure modes (e.g. dataset difficulty vs loss weighting) due to inherent multidimensional confounding.
rules.rationale: Observing domain transfer failure does not prove whether the failure arises from feature distribution shift, loss weights, or model capacity.
rules.enforcement: Reports analyzing cross-domain evaluations must classify conclusions as DESCRIPTIVE / TRANSFER_DIAGNOSTIC and disclaim causal attribution.

rules.title: Machine-Checkable Single-Variable Isolation for Diagnostic Training
rules.statement: Any diagnostic training experiment designed to test a causal hypothesis must vary exactly ONE independent parameter relative to the control baseline, keeping all other hyperparameters, data partitions, seeds, and architectures identically matched to the canonical protocol via automated machine assertions.
rules.rationale: Varying multiple parameters simultaneously (e.g. changing optimizer and loss weights) renders causal conclusions invalid.
rules.enforcement: Pre-flight checks for diagnostic runs must perform automated diff assertions against canonical protocol parameters.
